en.t: Constantine the Great was proclaimed Roman emperor by his troops after the death of Constantius Chlorus
en.s: Constantine I (27 February 272 – 22 May 337), also known as Constantine the Great, was Roman emperor from AD 306 to 337 and the first Roman emperor to convert to Christianity. He played a pivotal role in elevating the status of Christianity in the Roman Empire, the Edict of Milan decriminalising Christian practice and ceasing Christian persecution. This was a turning point in the Christianisation of the Roman Empire.

zh.t: 君士坦丁大帝在君士坦提乌斯·克洛鲁斯去世后被军队拥立为罗马皇帝
zh.s: 君士坦丁一世（272年2月27日—337年5月22日），又称君士坦丁大帝，公元306年至337年担任罗马皇帝，也是首位改信基督教的罗马皇帝。他对提升基督教在罗马帝国的地位发挥了关键作用；《米兰敕令》使基督教信仰不再属于非法，并终止了对基督徒的迫害。这是罗马帝国基督教化进程中的转折点。

en.t: Wang Geon becomes King of Goryeo after overthrowing Gung Ye in a coup the previous day
en.s: Taejo (Korean: 태조; Hanja: 太祖; 31 January 877 – 4 July 943), personal name Wang Kŏn (왕건; 王建), also known as Taejo Wang Kŏn (태조 왕건; 太祖 王建; lit. ''Great Progenitor Wang Kŏn''), was the founder of the Goryeo Dynasty of Korea. He ruled from 918 to 943, achieving unification of the Later Three Kingdoms in 936.

zh.t: 王建于前一日发动政变推翻弓裔后，成为高丽国王
zh.s: 太祖（韩语：태조；汉字：太祖；877年1月31日—943年7月4日），名王建（왕건；王建），又称王建太祖（태조 왕건；太祖王建；意为“大祖王建”），是朝鲜高丽王朝的创建者。他于918年至943年在位，并于936年统一后三国。

en.s: The Battle of Ourique (25 July 1139: St. James Day) saw the forces of Portuguese Prince Afonso Henriques (of the House of Burgundy) defeat the Almoravid Moors led by Ali ibn Yusuf.

zh.s: 奥里基战役于1139年7月25日（圣雅各伯日）爆发。勃艮第家族的葡萄牙王子阿方索·恩里克斯率军击败了由阿里·伊本·优素福率领的阿尔摩拉维德穆斯林军队。

en.s: The Reconquest of Constantinople was the recapture of the city of Constantinople in 1261 AD from the Latin Empire by Nicaean forces led by the general Alexios Strategopoulos. The reconquest of the city led to the re-establishment of the Byzantine Empire under the Palaiologos dynasty after an interval of 57 years, during which Constantinople had been the capital of the Latin Empire, a crusader state installed by Latin forces of the Fourth Crusade following the sack of Constantinople in 1204.

zh.s: 1261年，尼西亚军队在将领阿莱克修斯·斯特拉特戈普洛斯率领下，从拉丁帝国手中夺回君士坦丁堡。收复该城后，巴列奥略王朝重建了拜占庭帝国。此前57年间，君士坦丁堡一直是拉丁帝国的首都；这个十字军国家是在1204年第四次十字军东征攻陷君士坦丁堡后，由拉丁军队建立的。

en.s: The Battle of Algeciras was a naval battle which occurred on July 25, 1278. The battle pitted the fleets of the Kingdom of Castile, commanded by the Admiral of Castile, Pedro Martínez de Fe, and the combined fleets of the Sultanate of Morocco and that of the Emirate of Granada, commanded by Abu Yaqub Yusuf an-Nasr. The battle was fought in the context of the Moorish naval expeditions to the Iberian Peninsula. The battle, which took place in the Strait of Gibraltar, resulted in a Muslim victory. This battle coincided with a simultaneous siege of the city of Algeciras which lasted from 1278–79 and was commanded by the Infante Sancho.

zh.s: 1278年7月25日，卡斯蒂利亚王国舰队与摩洛哥苏丹国和格拉纳达埃米尔国的联合舰队在直布罗陀海峡交战。卡斯蒂利亚舰队由海军上将佩德罗·马丁内斯·德费指挥，联合舰队由阿布·雅各布·优素福·安纳赛尔统领。战斗发生在摩尔人向伊比利亚半岛发动海上远征期间，以穆斯林联军获胜告终。与此同时，桑乔王子指挥部队围攻阿尔赫西拉斯城，围城从1278年持续到1279年。

en.s: The Battle of Alessandria or Battle of Castelazzo was a battle during the Florentine–Milanese Wars which was fought at Alessandria, Piedmont, Italy on 25 July 1391 between the mercenary army of Gian Galeazzo Visconti of Milan and a French army in Florentine service, under Jean III of Armagnac. It ended in victory for Milan.

zh.s: 亚历山德里亚战役又称卡斯特拉佐战役，于1391年7月25日在意大利皮埃蒙特的亚历山德里亚爆发，是佛罗伦萨-米兰战争的一部分。交战双方是米兰的吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂率领的雇佣军，以及让三世·达尔马尼亚克率领、为佛罗伦萨效力的法国军队。战斗以米兰获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Riccardina or Battle of Molinella, fought on July 25, 1467, in Molinella, was one of the most important battles of the 15th century in Italy.

zh.s: 里卡尔迪纳战役又称莫利内拉战役，于1467年7月25日在莫利内拉爆发，是15世纪意大利最重要的战役之一。

en.s: The Conquest of Tripoli was a maritime campaign led by Pedro Navarro which captured the city of Tripoli in North Africa in the name of the Crown of Aragon in 1510.

zh.s: 1510年，佩德罗·纳瓦罗率领海上军事行动，为阿拉贡王室夺取了北非城市的黎波里。

en.s: The Battle of Sződfalva or Battle of Sedfal field (Hungarian: Sződfalvi csata, Serbian: Бој на Седфалском пољу (Boj na Sedfalskom polju)) was fought on July 25, 1527, between voivodian Serbs, under Jovan Nenad, and the Transylvanian army of (Hungarians and Saxons). In the battle, Jovan Nenad was defeated by a much larger force, and many of his troops dispersed into Syrmia after the defeat. When Ferdinand of Austria won, the Serbs maintained an autonomous principality in the area that lasted until 1540.

zh.s: 瑟德法尔瓦战役又称瑟德法尔草原战役（匈牙利语：Sződfalvi csata；塞尔维亚语：Бој на Седфалском пољу，转写：Boj na Sedfalskom polju），于1527年7月25日爆发。约万·内纳德率领的伏伊伏丁那塞族军队与匈牙利人和萨克森人组成的特兰西瓦尼亚军队交战。约万·内纳德的军队被人数远多于己方的敌军击败，许多士兵战后逃散到叙尔米亚。奥地利的斐迪南获胜后，塞族人在当地维持了一个自治公国，直到1540年。

en.t: The city of Guayaquil is founded by the Spanish Conquistador Francisco de Orellana and given the name Muy Noble y Muy Leal Ciudad de Santiago de Guayaquil
en.s: Guayaquil (Spanish pronunciation: [ɡwaʝaˈkil] ), officially Santiago de Guayaquil, is the capital of Guayas Province and the seat of Guayaquil Canton. It is the largest city in Ecuador and also the nation's economic capital and main port. The city is located on the west bank of the Guayas River, which flows into the Pacific Ocean at the Gulf of Guayaquil.

zh.t: 西班牙征服者弗朗西斯科·德·奥雷利亚纳建立瓜亚基尔城，并命名为“非常高贵且非常忠诚的圣地亚哥·德·瓜亚基尔城”
zh.s: 瓜亚基尔（西班牙语发音：[ɡwaʝaˈkil]），正式名称为圣地亚哥·德·瓜亚基尔，是瓜亚斯省首府和瓜亚基尔县治，也是厄瓜多尔最大城市、该国经济首都和主要港口。该市位于瓜亚斯河西岸，瓜亚斯河在瓜亚基尔湾注入太平洋。

en.s: The Battle of Muros Bay (Spanish: Batalla de Muros) took place on 25 July 1543, during the Italian War of 1542–1546, between the French fleet under Jean de Clamorgan, Lord of Soane and the Spanish fleet commanded by Don Álvaro de Bazán, 1st Marquis of Viso, father of Don Álvaro de Bazán, 1st Marquis of Santa Cruz, who was also present at the battle being no more than 18 years old. This battle is considered to be the first big Atlantic naval battle.

zh.s: 穆罗斯湾海战（西班牙语：Batalla de Muros）于1543年7月25日在1542年至1546年意大利战争期间爆发。交战双方是让·德·克拉莫尔冈勋爵指挥的法国舰队，以及唐·阿尔瓦罗·德·巴赞（第一代维索侯爵）指挥的西班牙舰队。西班牙舰队司令的儿子唐·阿尔瓦罗·德·巴赞（第一代圣克鲁斯侯爵）也参加了战斗，当时他至多18岁。这场战斗被认为是大西洋上的第一场大型海战。

en.t: Henry II of France is crowned
en.s: Henry II (French: Henri II; 31 March 1519 – 10 July 1559) was King of France from 1547 until his death in 1559. The second son of Francis I and Claude, Duchess of Brittany, he became Dauphin of France upon the death of his elder brother Francis in 1536. As a child, Henry and his elder brother spent over four years in captivity in Spain as hostages in exchange for their father.

zh.t: 法国国王亨利二世加冕
zh.s: 亨利二世（法语：Henri II；1519年3月31日—1559年7月10日）于1547年至1559年去世期间担任法国国王。他是弗朗索瓦一世与布列塔尼女公爵克洛德的次子，1536年兄长弗朗索瓦去世后成为法国王太子。亨利小时候曾与兄长在西班牙被扣作人质，以交换他们的父亲；两人被扣押了四年多。

en.s: The siege of Mankot (1557) was a major confrontation between the Sur Empire and the Mughal Empire led by a young Akbar. It was one of the last events of the Mughal reconquest, and the first major military encounter of the young Akbar, who was still under the regency of Bairam Khan. In 1557, Sikandar Shah Suri had taken refuge in the castle of Mankot with his troops. The Afghan garrison resisted during 6 months using artillery and matchlocks, but had to surrender when food ran out. Sikandar surrendered to the Mughal forces led by Bairam Khan on 25 July 1557.

zh.s: 1557年，苏尔帝国与年轻的阿克巴领导的莫卧儿帝国在曼科特围城战中发生重要交锋。这是莫卧儿帝国收复失地行动的最后几起事件之一，也是年轻的阿克巴参与的首场重要军事行动；当时他仍处于拜拉姆汗摄政之下。1557年，西坎达尔·沙阿·苏尔率部避入曼科特城堡。阿富汗守军用火炮和火绳枪抵抗了六个月，但粮食耗尽后被迫投降。1557年7月25日，西坎达尔向拜拉姆汗率领的莫卧儿军队投降。

en.s: The Battle of Salga occurred on 25 July 1581, around the Bay of Salga and along the coastal part of the parish of Vila de São Sebastião, on the island of Terceira in the Portuguese Azores, between Spanish and Portuguese forces. The latter, in the name of António, Prior of Crato, successfully defended the island against the personal union with the Spanish crown during the War of the Portuguese Succession.

zh.s: 萨尔加战役于1581年7月25日在葡萄牙亚速尔群岛特塞拉岛的萨尔加湾及圣塞巴斯蒂昂镇沿海一带爆发，交战双方是西班牙军队和葡萄牙军队。葡萄牙军队以克拉托修道院长安东尼奥的名义作战，在葡萄牙王位继承战争期间成功保卫该岛，抵抗与西班牙王室合并。

en.s: The Siege of Knodsenburg, Relief of Knodzenburg or also known as Battle of the Betuwe was a military action that took place during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War at a sconce known as Knodsenburg in the district of Nijmegen. A siege by a Spanish army under the command of the Duke of Parma took place from 15th to the 25th July 1591. The fort was defended by the Dutch Republic's commander Gerrit de Jong and his company which was then subsequently relieved through the intervention of a Dutch and English army led by Maurice of Orange and Francis Vere respectively on July 25.

zh.s: 克诺森堡围城战又称克诺森堡解围战或贝图韦战役，是八十年战争和英西战争期间发生在奈梅亨地区克诺森堡棱堡的一次军事行动。西班牙军队在帕尔马公爵指挥下于1591年7月15日至25日围攻该堡。荷兰共和国指挥官赫里特·德容及其部队守卫棱堡。7月25日，奥兰治的莫里斯和弗朗西斯·维尔分别率领荷兰与英国联军前来解围。

en.t: Coronation of James I and Anne
en.s: The coronation of James I and his wife Anne of Denmark as king and queen of England and Ireland was held on 25 July 1603 at Westminster Abbey. James had reigned as king of Scotland since 1567. Anne was anointed and consecrated with prayers alluding to Esther, the Wise Virgins, and other Biblical heroines. It was the first coronation to be conducted in English instead of Latin.

zh.t: 詹姆斯一世与安妮加冕典礼
zh.s: 1603年7月25日，詹姆斯一世和丹麦的安妮在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰和爱尔兰国王与王后。詹姆斯自1567年起已是苏格兰国王。典礼为安妮举行了涂油和祝圣仪式，并祈祷提及以斯帖、十个童女和其他《圣经》中的女英雄。这是首次使用英语而非拉丁语举行的加冕典礼。

en.t: Coronation of James VI and I
en.s: James VI and I (James Charles Stuart; 19 June 1566 – 27 March 1625) was King of Scotland as James VI from 24 July 1567, and King of England and Ireland as James I from the union of the Scottish and English crowns on 24 March 1603, until his death in 1625.

zh.t: 詹姆斯六世及一世加冕
zh.s: 詹姆斯六世及一世（詹姆斯·查尔斯·斯图亚特；1566年6月19日—1625年3月27日）自1567年7月24日起以詹姆斯六世之名担任苏格兰国王；1603年3月24日苏格兰和英格兰王冠合一后，以詹姆斯一世之名担任英格兰和爱尔兰国王，直至1625年去世。

en.s: The Battle of Neu Titschein or Titschein (Moravia, now Nový Jičín, Czech Republic) was fought on 25 July 1621 during the Thirty Years' War between the Roman Catholic forces of Jean de Gauchier and the Protestant army of Johann Georg Jägerndorf of Hohenzollern. After the defeat of the Bohemian Protestant army in the battle of White mountain, part of its forces remained in Silesia. Protestant nobleman Johann Georg Jägerndorf of Hohenzollern, a Protestant leader in Silesia, decided to restore Protestant power in the Bohemian kingdom.

zh.s: 新蒂茨海因战役又称蒂茨海因战役，发生在摩拉维亚（今捷克新伊钦），于1621年7月25日在三十年战争期间爆发。天主教军队由让·德·戈希耶指挥，新教军队则由霍亨索伦-耶格恩多夫的约翰·格奥尔格率领。白山战役中波希米亚新教军队战败后，其部分部队留在西里西亚。西里西亚的新教领袖、霍亨索伦-耶格恩多夫的约翰·格奥尔格决定恢复新教势力在波希米亚王国的统治。

en.s: The Great Siege of Scarborough Castle was a major conflict for control of one of England's most important stone fortresses during the First English Civil War fought between the Parliamentarians and the Royalists loyal to King Charles I. In February 1645, Parliamentarians laid siege to Scarborough Castle. For five months, they bombarded it, destroying most of the keep, and engaged in bloody fighting before the defenders finally surrendered.

zh.t: 斯卡伯勒城堡大围城战
zh.s: 第一次英国内战期间，议会派和效忠查理一世的保王派为争夺英格兰最重要的石砌堡垒之一斯卡伯勒城堡展开激战。1645年2月，议会派开始围攻城堡。此后5个月，他们持续炮击，摧毁了大部分主塔，并与守军激战，最终守军投降。

en.s: A major earthquake occurred during the rule of the Qing dynasty in Shandong Province on July 25, 1668. It had an estimated magnitude of Ms 8.5, making it the largest historical earthquake in East China, and one of the largest to occur on land. An estimated 43,000 to 50,000 people were killed, and its effects were widely felt.

zh.s: 清朝统治期间，山东省于1668年7月25日发生强烈地震。震级估计为面波震级8.5级，是华东有历史记载以来最大的地震，也是陆地上发生的最大地震之一。估计有43,000至50,000人死亡，地震影响范围很广。

en.s: Dummer's War (1722–1725) was a series of battles between the New England Colonies and the Wabanaki Confederacy (specifically the Mi'kmaq, Maliseet, Penobscot, and Abenaki), who were allied with New France. The eastern theater of the war was located primarily along the border between New England and Acadia in Maine, as well as in Nova Scotia; the western theater was located in northern Massachusetts and Vermont in the frontier areas between Canada (New France) and New England.

zh.s: 达默尔战争（1722—1725年）是新英格兰殖民地与瓦巴纳基联盟之间的一系列战斗。瓦巴纳基联盟包括米克马克人、马利塞特人、佩诺布斯科特人和阿贝纳基人，并与新法兰西结盟。东部战场主要位于新英格兰与阿卡迪亚交界处，包括缅因州和新斯科舍；西部战场位于马萨诸塞州北部和佛蒙特州、加拿大（新法兰西）与新英格兰交界的边境地区。

en.s: The siege of Cuddalore was a siege attempt by British troops against a combined French and Mysorean garrison at the fortress of Cuddalore in the Second Anglo-Mysore War. The siege ended when news arrived of a preliminary peace treaty between France and Britain.
en.n: American Revolutionary War: The war's last action, the Siege of Cuddalore, is ended by a preliminary peace agreement.

zh.s: 在第二次英迈索尔战争期间，英军围攻了库达洛尔堡垒，守军由法军和迈索尔军队组成。法国与英国达成初步和平条约的消息传来后，围城结束。
zh.n: 美国独立战争：最后一场军事行动库达洛尔围城战在初步和平协议达成后结束。

en.s: Charles William Ferdinand (German: Karl Wilhelm Ferdinand; 9 October 1735 – 10 November 1806) was the ruling prince of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel, hereditary duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg and a military leader. His titles are usually shortened to Duke of Brunswick in English-language sources. He succeeded his father as sovereign prince of the Principality of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel, one of the princely states of the Holy Roman Empire.

en.s: The Battle of Lundy's Lane (also known as the Battle of Niagara Falls) was a battle of the Anglo-American War of 1812, which took place on 25 July 1814, in present-day Niagara Falls, Ontario. It was one of the bloodiest battles of the war, and one of the deadliest battles ever fought in Canada. The battle was a tactical draw but a British strategic victory because the Americans had suffered so many casualties that they were now outnumbered. There were over 1,500 casualties including 258 killed.

zh.s: 朗迪巷战役又称尼亚加拉瀑布战役，是1812年英美战争中的一场战斗，于1814年7月25日在今加拿大安大略省尼亚加拉瀑布市发生。这是该战争中伤亡最惨重的战役之一，也是加拿大历史上伤亡最惨重的战役之一。战斗在战术上没有胜负，但英国取得战略胜利，因为美军损失惨重，兵力此后处于劣势。双方伤亡超过1,500人，其中258人死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Isted took place on 25 July 1850 near the village of Idstedt (Danish: Isted), today Schleswig-Holstein, Germany. The battle was part of the First Schleswig War. The battle began early in the morning at around 2:00 and lasted until 19:00. The Danish took 1072 unwounded and 411 wounded prisoners. The Danish victory broke the Holstein army for good. The Isted Lion commemorates the battle, which was at its time the largest in Scandinavian history. The battle's anniversary, 25 July, is a military flag day in Denmark. N. F. S.

zh.s: 伊斯特德战役于1850年7月25日在伊德斯泰特村附近爆发；该地今属德国石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州。战役是第一次石勒苏益格战争的一部分，清晨约2时开战，持续至19时。丹麦军俘获1,072名未受伤和411名受伤的士兵。丹麦获胜后，荷尔斯泰因军队彻底瓦解。伊斯特德狮纪念碑为纪念这场战役而建；当时它是斯堪的纳维亚历史上规模最大的战役。丹麦将7月25日战役纪念日定为军事旗日。N. F. S.……

en.s: The First Battle of Mesilla, was fought on July 25, 1861 at Mesilla in New Mexico Territory, in present day Doña Ana County, New Mexico. It was an engagement between Confederate and Union forces during the American Civil War. The battle resulted in a Confederate victory and led directly to the official establishing of a Confederate Arizona Territory, consisting of the southern portion of the New Mexico Territory. The victory paved the way for the Confederate New Mexico Campaign the following year.

en.s: The Crittenden–Johnson Resolution (also known as the Crittenden Resolution and the War Aims Resolution) was proposed in the United States Congress early in the American Civil War as a conciliatory message to the slave states assuring them that the Northern war effort was not aimed at interfering with their rights to slavery, but solely towards restoring the Union.

en.s: The First Sino-Japanese War (25 July 1894 – 17 April 1895) was a conflict between the Qing dynasty of China and the Empire of Japan primarily for influence over Korea. After roughly 7 months of sustained military gains by Japanese land and naval forces and the loss of the ports of Lüshunkou (Port Arthur) and Weihaiwei, the Qing government sued for peace in February 1895 and signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki two months later, ending the war.

zh.s: 第一次中日战争（1894年7月25日—1895年4月17日）是清朝与日本帝国之间的战争，双方主要争夺对朝鲜的影响力。在中国，这场战争通常称为甲午战争。日本陆军和海军持续取得战果，约七个月后旅顺口和威海卫相继失守。1895年2月，清政府请求议和，两个月后签署《马关条约》，战争结束。

en.s: The Ngiao rebellion (Thai: กบฏเงี้ยว), also called the Phrae City Rebellion and the 1902 Shan rebellion, was an uprising of Tai Yai (Shan, historically known in Thai as Ngiao) people against Siamese rule, in what is now Phrae province in northern Thailand between 25 July and 14 August in 1902. It arose as resistance to centralizing reforms initiated by King Chulalongkorn, particularly the levying of taxes and the adoption of the Monthon Thesaphiban provincial administration system, as well as the partitioning of territory with the British, which forced the Shan to adopt either British or Siamese nationality. In the morning of 25 July 1902, rebels attacked and looted the town of Phrae, killing over twenty government officials including the royal commissioner, Phraya Ratcharitthanon.

zh.s: 恩胶叛乱（泰语：กบฏเงี้ยว）又称帕府起义或1902年掸族叛乱，是1902年7月25日至8月14日期间发生在今泰国北部帕府的一场起义。掸族（历史上泰语称“恩胶”）反抗暹罗统治。起义源于朱拉隆功国王推行的中央集权改革，尤其是征税、采用“月份制”省级行政体系，以及与英国划分领土，迫使掸族选择英国或暹罗国籍。1902年7月25日上午，起义军袭击并洗劫帕城，杀害了20多名政府官员，其中包括王室专员帕耶·拉差里塔农。

en.s: The Battle of San Fernando took place on July 25, 1927 during the American occupation of Nicaragua of 1926–1933. Shortly after the Battle of Ocotal, an expedition of seventy-eight American Marines and thirty-seven Nicaraguan Provisional Guardsmen led by Major Oliver Floyd were sent hunting for rebel leader Augusto César Sandino. One of their destinations was the town of San Fernando, where Sandino had about forty men waiting for the Marines and their Nicaraguan allies. He placed a sentry outside the village to alert his men of the Marines and Provisional Guard's arrival, but the watchman abandoned his post to be alone with an Indian girl in a nearby shack.

en.s: Operation Spring (July 25–27, 1944) was an offensive operation of the Second World War conducted by II Canadian Corps during the Normandy campaign in 1944. en.s: The Newport Folk Festival is an annual American folk-oriented music festival in Newport, Rhode Island, which began in 1959 as a counterpart to the Newport Jazz Festival. The festival was founded by music promoter and Jazz Festival founder George Wein, music manager Albert Grossman, and folk singers Pete Seeger, Theodore Bikel, and Oscar Brand. zh.s: 纽波特民谣音乐节是美国罗德岛州纽波特市每年举办的民谣音乐节，1959年创办，是纽波特爵士音乐节的姊妹活动。音乐推广人、爵士音乐节创办人乔治·韦恩，以及音乐经纪人艾伯特·格罗斯曼和民谣歌手皮特·西格、特奥多尔·比克尔、奥斯卡·布兰德共同创办了这一音乐节。它是美国最早的现代音乐节之一，至今仍是民谣音乐的重要活动。

en.s: The Viking program consisted of a pair of identical American space probes, Viking 1 and Viking 2 both launched in 1975, and landed on Mars in 1976. en.s: On July 25, 1993, Israeli forces launched a week-long attack against Lebanon named Operation Accountability (Hebrew: מבצע דין וחשבון, romanized: Mivtza Din VeHeshbon) in Israel and the Seven-Day War (Arabic: حرب الأيام السبعة) in Lebanon. en.s: The 1996 Burundian coup d'état was a military coup d'état that took place in Burundi on 25 July 1996. In the midst of the Burundi Civil War, former president Pierre Buyoya (a Tutsi) deposed Hutu President Sylvestre Ntibantunganya. This was Buyoya's second successful coup, having overthrown Jean-Baptiste Bagaza in 1987.

en.t: Phoolan Devi, a serving Member of Parliament, is assassinated by shooting in New Delhi, India
en.s: Phoolan Devi (Hindi: [pʰuː.lən d̪eː.ʋiː]; 10 August 1963 – 25 July 2001), popularly known as the Bandit Queen, was an Indian dacoit (bandit) who became a politician, serving as a member of parliament until her assassination. en.s: Pratibha Devisingh Patil (born 19 December 1934), also known as Pratibha Patil Shekhawat, is an Indian stateswoman and lawyer who served as the president of India from 2007 to 2012. en.s: The Afghan War documents leak, also called the Afghan War Diary, is the disclosure of a collection of internal U.S. military logs of the War in Afghanistan, which were published by WikiLeaks on 25 July 2010. The logs consist of over 91,000 Afghan War documents, covering the period between January 2004 and December 2009. Most of the documents are classified secret. As of 28 July 2010, only 75,000 of the documents have been released to the public, a move which Wikileaks says is "part of a harm minimization process demanded by [the] source".

en.s: Operation Martyr Yalçın (Turkish: Şehit Yalçın Operasyonu) was a military operation conducted by the Turkish Air Force against Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) positions in Syria and Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) positions in Northern Iraq on 24 and 25 July 2015. The operation began in the early hours of 24 July, a day after ISIL militants reportedly attacked a Turkish military border outpost in the Turkish town of Elbeyli in Kilis Province, killing one soldier, named Yalçın Nane, and injuring two others. The operation is named after the soldier killed in the initial attack, Yalçın Nane.

zh.s: “殉国者亚尔钦”行动（土耳其语：Şehit Yalçın Operasyonu）是土耳其空军于2015年7月24日至25日发动的一次军事行动，打击叙利亚境内的伊斯兰国（ISIL）据点，以及伊拉克北部库尔德工人党（PKK）的据点。行动于7月24日凌晨开始。此前一天，伊斯兰国武装分子据报袭击了土耳其基利斯省埃尔贝伊利镇的一处边境哨所，打死士兵亚尔钦·纳内，并造成另外两人受伤。此次行动以这名阵亡士兵命名。

en.t: 2018 Pakistani general election in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
en.s: General elections were held in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on Wednesday, 25 July 2018 to elect the 51 members of 15th National Assembly from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
